service: baan-thai-backend

useDotenv: true

package:
  patterns:
    - 'node_modules/**'
    - '!node_modules/aws-sdk/**'

plugins:
  - serverless-dotenv-plugin
  - serverless-offline

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: eu-north-1
  iam:
    role: ${env:IAM_ROLE_ARN}

  environment:
    TABLE_NAME: RestaurantTable
    JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET}
    API_KEY: ${env:API_KEY}

  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - "*"
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
        - x-api-key
      allowedMethods:
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE

functions:
  #  -------------------USER---------------------
  handleRegister: # register as user or admin
    handler: functions/auth/RegisterUser/handleRegister.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/register
          method: POST

  handleLogin: # logs in user or admin
    handler: functions/auth/LoginUser/handleLogin.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/login
          method: POST

  getUserProfile: # gets the userId's profile
    handler: functions/auth/GetUserProfile/getUserProfile.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/profile/{userId}
          method: GET

  updateUserProfile: # updates user profile (email, phoneNumber, address)
    handler: functions/auth/UpdateUserProfile/updateUserProfile.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/profile/{userId}
          method: PUT

  getAdminUsers: # gets all users with admin role
    handler: functions/auth/GetAdminUsers/getAdminUsers.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users
          method: GET

  updateUser: # updates a specific user (admin only)
    handler: functions/auth/UpdateUser/updateUser.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/{userId}
          method: PUT

  deleteUser: # deletes a specific user (admin only)
    handler: functions/auth/DeleteUser/deleteUser.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/{userId}
          method: DELETE

  #  -------------------MENU---------------------
  getMenu: # get all meals from the menu
    handler: functions/menu/getMenu.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu
          method: GET

  getProduct: # gets a single menu item
    handler: functions/menu/getProduct.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu/{prodId}
          method: GET

  createMenuItem: # add a new meal to menu
    handler: functions/menu/createMenuItem.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu
          method: POST

  updateMenuItem: # change a meal in menu
    handler: functions/menu/updateMenuItem.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu/{prodId}
          method: PUT

  deleteMenuItem: # removes menu product (menu item === a meal)
    handler: functions/menu/deleteMenuItem.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu/{prodId}
          method: DELETE

  #  -------------------ORDERS---------------------
  createOrder: # creates an order
    handler: functions/order/PostCreateOrder/postCreateOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders
          method: POST

  getAllOrders: # gets all orders
    handler: functions/order/GetAllOrders/getAllOrders.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders
          method: GET

  getOrderbyUserId: # gets all orders by userId
    handler: functions/order/GetOrdersByUserId/getOrdersByUserId.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{userId}
          method: GET

  getOrdersByStatus: # gets all orders by status (pending, locked, completed)
    handler: functions/order/GetOrdersByStatus/getOrdersByStatus.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/status/{status}
          method: GET

  updateOrderStatus: # change order status (pending, locked, complete)
    handler: functions/order/UpdateOrderStatus/updateOrderStatus.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/status
          method: PUT

  cancelOrder: # userId cancels order (only pending orders)
    handler: functions/order/CancelOrder/cancelOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/cancel
          method: PUT

  editOrder: # changes an order in case user did something wrong/forgot to add something (only pending orders)
    handler: functions/order/EditOrder/editOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/edit
          method: PUT

  deleteOrder: # deletes an order completely
    handler: functions/order/DeleteOrder/deleteOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}
          method: DELETE

  adminEditOrder: # changes an order in case user did something wrong/forgot to add something (only pending orders)
    handler: functions/order/AdminEditOrder/adminEditOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/edit/admin
          method: PUT

  #  -------------------NOTIFICATIONS---------------------
  getNotifications: # gets all notifications for a user
    handler: functions/notifications/GetNotifications/getNotifications.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/notifications/{userId}
          method: GET

  markNotificationAsRead: # marks a single notification as read
    handler: functions/notifications/MarkAsRead/markAsRead.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/notifications/{notificationId}/read
          method: PUT

  markAllNotificationsAsRead: # marks all notifications as read for a user
    handler: functions/notifications/MarkAllAsRead/markAllAsRead.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/notifications/{userId}/read-all
          method: PUT
